svg.title: From sale record to reconciled recovery
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-end-to-end-workflow; chart type: process_flow; title: From sale record to reconciled recovery; subtitle: Separate tax-sale and foreclosure procedures; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values indicate sequence, not duration or probability of recovery.; caption: A posted surplus is an investigation starting point; verify custody, priority and entitlement before estimating a claimant's proceeds.; stages: label: Identify sale; value: Step 1; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Record parcel, case number, sale date and whether the sale was tax-related or mortgage foreclosure.; label: Verify funds; value: Step 2; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Reconcile the sale accounting with the current custodian ledger; exclude paid, transferred or duplicated balances.; label: Resolve priority; value: Step 3; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Trace title, lien claims and the claimant's identity; refer disputed ranking and entitlement to counsel.; label: Document authority; value: Step 4; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Check deadlines and permitted compensation; assemble the signed engagement and evidence of representative authority.; label: Submit and reconcile; value: Step 5; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Use the custodian or court procedure, track objections and reconcile distribution against collected fees.
